newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos guards seize barber for displaying scissors.
newsitem.headline: Ramos guards seize barber for displaying scissors.

text.p: A drunken barber was arrested in the southern Philippine city of Iligan on Tuesday after he pulled out a pair of scissors while watching President Fidel Ramos inspect a new slaughterhouse.

"The barber was 15 to 20 meters away from the President when he took out his scissors so there was a squabble between him and the guards," Press Undersecretary Marcelo Lagmay told Reuters by telephone.
"There was really no attempt on the life of the president, but any security man seeing a person carrying a bladed weapon would be alarmed," said Lagmay.
The 60-year-old barber, Timoteo Mahusay, was in a crowd watching Ramos at the slaughterhouse when he pulled out the scissors.
Lagmay said Mahusay was later released and no decision had been made on whether he would face any charges.
